# DriveHub Goa — Self-Drive Car Rental Service Information
> Enterprise Self-Drive Car Rental Provider in Goa, India.

## Business Summary
DriveHub Goa offers premium self-drive car rentals across North Goa and South Goa with transparent pricing, zero hidden charges, unlimited kilometers options, and 24/7 airport delivery.

## Key Fleet Offerings & Pricing (INR/day)
- Hatchbacks (Maruti Swift, Tata Tiago, Hyundai i10): ₹1,400 - ₹2,200/day
- Sedans (Maruti Dzire, Hyundai Verna, Honda City): ₹1,800 - ₹3,000/day
- Compact & Full SUVs (Brezza, Ertiga 7-seater, Creta, Fortuner): ₹2,500 - ₹5,000/day
- Off-Road 4x4 (Mahindra Thar 4x4): ₹3,500 - ₹4,500/day
- Convertible & Luxury (MINI Cooper Convertible, BMW Z4, Mercedes C300): ₹7,500 - ₹16,000/day

## Pickup & Delivery Hubs
- Complimentary Hubs: Candolim (Main Hub), Calangute, Baga
- Airport Delivery (24/7): Dabolim Airport (GOI) & Mopa Airport (GOX) (Surcharge: ₹800 - ₹1,200)

## Booking Requirements
- Valid Indian Driving License or International Driving Permit (IDP)
- Government ID (Aadhaar or Passport)
- Refundable Security Deposit: ₹3,000 to ₹30,000 depending on vehicle class

## Official Website & Inquiries
- Website: https://drivehubgoa.com
- Direct Booking Engine: https://drivehubgoa.com/fleet
- Primary Hub Location: Fort Aguada Road, Candolim, North Goa, India (403515)
